## Summary

This PR updates the maintained brand ownership, source-of-truth, and acceptance guides to match the current repository and preserve the verified history of earlier decisions and handoffs. It adopts the scoped corrections authored in follow-up #27, records the latest source comparison against brand-kit main e254df5444f0bfedd5526b0e148b0cdf36cbd31f, and preserves the immutable 14-SVG comparison as bounded evidence. The changes are documentation only; they do not grant brand, rights, release, or consumer approval.

## Linked issues

Refs Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit#27 · Refs Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com#117

- **Issue key:** N/A — this organization-wide documentation audit has no assigned brand acceptance issue. #27 is the corrective documentation PR; #117 is a documented integration dependency.

## Scope / Non-goals

- **In scope:** correct three maintained documentation files, preserve source ownership and historical evidence, and link to canonical product/master references.
- **Non-goals:** changing assets, tokens, code, package versions, application behavior, identity decisions, rights or font clearance, public export authorization, releases, provider use, or consumer acceptance.

## Changes

- docs/architecture/OWNERSHIP.md records the current main source pin and keeps the dated visibility history, PR #2 handoff, PR #22 links, PR #3 unresolved proposals, and the 14-SVG evidence scoped to matching Git blobs. The comparison does not establish rights, a selected brand version, distribution approval, or consumer ACK.
- docs/source-of-truth.md marks former proposed layout/icon references as historical and retains the reviewer-role correction merged through PR #28.
- docs/architecture/ACCEPTANCE.md points to the canonical integration-evals authority and does not mirror or assert master status.
- The branch head aa22b3833a7510e1ece215926faab6c6394e5258 has the current main e254df5444f0bfedd5526b0e148b0cdf36cbd31f as its second parent. Its tree changes only the three documentation files relative to current main; no asset, token, dependency, approval record, or application file changes.

## Ownership & design

- **Affected ownership / interfaces:** brand-kit owns identity sources and guidance; Product owns application assembly; event-intelligence owns event asset discovery/permission evaluation; creative-engine owns artwork versioning; print-production owns printable composition; shared-contracts owns canonical interfaces; integration-evals owns master acceptance. No ownership is reassigned.
- **Design / ADR / catalog links:** [brand source-of-truth index at this candidate](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/aa22b3833a7510e1ece215926faab6c6394e5258/docs/source-of-truth.md), [PR #3 reconciliation](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/aa22b3833a7510e1ece215926faab6c6394e5258/docs/identity-decision-packet.md#pr-3-reconciliation), and [shared contract catalog](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts/blob/91736a026c02a3206cb7666ebfbe6134692e5a24/docs/contract-catalog.md). The current product architecture link targets getticketstub.com PR #117 and resolves on its default branch only after that companion merges. The v1.0 architecture kit remains dated design intent.

## Acceptance criteria → evidence

No new product or master acceptance criterion is created by this documentation PR.

- [x] Preserve verified source and ownership history while distinguishing historical proposals from current files — corrected pages retain their dated evidence and named owners.
- [x] Keep the 14-SVG comparison separate from rights, distribution, version selection, and consumer acceptance — exact evidence pins remain in the source guide.

pr3_hold_comments.body:
## Independent review: REQUEST CHANGES

Reviewed exact head **289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3** against base **74bc86fe5b520cae792066fbe0d7dd129664bbd3** on 2026-10-12. This is a review comment, not brand approval or a merge instruction.

### Merge blockers

1. **P1 — Do not assert A-only is decided without its approval record.** [SPEC.md:26–29](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3/SPEC.md#L26-L29) changes the master app direction to “Dropped for the app” / “Decided: A only”; the same rule is added to motion and foil guidance. [BK-02's current decision comment](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/issues/9#issuecomment-6104392189) explicitly requires a recorded, approved decision before this PR merges. [The approver nomination](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/issues/8#issuecomment-6113526793) and [owner-team/font receipt](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/issues/8#issuecomment-6116787775) do not supply that decision: they identify CompleteDotTech as accountable approver, record CompleteDotTech/LaJefa/Lars as the owner team, preserve the no-self-hosted-font constraint, and expressly withhold approval of unseen identity/artifacts. Current consumer use of paper is implementation evidence, not ratification. Record the real dated decision against exact files/SHA and its app-versus-marketing scope, or remove the policy change from this link-repair PR. This review does not ratify either A+B or A-only.

2. **P2 — Reconcile the canonical references if the direction change is retained.** [The changed spec](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3/SPEC.md#L29) says the studio never has a dark stage, but [README.md:23](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3/README.md#L23), [index.html:283–287](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3/index.html#L283-L287), and [tokens/tokens.css:1–3](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit/blob/289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3/tokens/tokens.css#L1-L3) still tell consumers to switch to the night stage for printing/reveal/finishes/tear. The board also retains the thermal-whirr/source-from-cuelume sound guidance while this PR prescribes synthesized stepper ticks. A consumer cannot select a single intended rule from these canonical entry points. After an actual owner decision, update the affected guidance together and explicitly retain/scope dark tokens for permitted marketing/print uses. Merely leaving the contradiction for BK-03A is insufficient for this policy-changing head.

### Upstream links: now resolved in source

The old 404/merge-order blocker is cleared. getticketstub.com [PR #4](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/4) and [PR #20](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/20) are merged. At current main **388005240aa62374d49f709afc300adb5e98cd98**, these paths were read successfully:

- [docs/studio/stub-system.md](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/388005240aa62374d49f709afc300adb5e98cd98/docs/studio/stub-system.md)
- [docs/studio/research/holo-foil-technique.md](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/388005240aa62374d49f709afc300adb5e98cd98/docs/studio/research/holo-foil-technique.md)
- [/parts route source](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/388005240aa62374d49f709afc300adb5e98cd98/src/app/parts/page.tsx), which renders PartsBoard; [feedback.ts](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/388005240aa62374d49f709afc300adb5e98cd98/src/customer/studio/feedback.ts) also exists in the source tree.

This verifies source availability, not a deployed `/parts` endpoint or whole-product readiness. The PR description's current upstream-blocker statements are stale.

### Narrow follow-up

Prepare a link-only revision/PR: retain the README/SPEC/foil-source/token-description path corrections, update README's stale `ticket-studio` status sentence, and refresh the PR dependency evidence. Move the A-only and new foil/motion/sound policy into a clearly pending BK-02/BK-08 review proposal. That proposal should request the exact scoped owner decision and carry the corresponding README/board/token-guidance reconciliation; it must not invent approval. This allows the verified link repair to advance independently.

### Verification

- `git diff --check 74bc86fe5b520cae792066fbe0d7dd129664bbd3...289b22659f0699649abd65ba7a3b7e710839f4d3`: PASS.
- Exact-head `tokens/tokens.json` parses: PASS.
- Diff contains five documentation/description files; no logo SVGs or token numeric values change. Logo generation was not rerun during this read-only review.
- No status checks are attached to this PR. No consumer files, local repository files, or branches were changed; no merge performed.

@lmvdz Lars, Timothy asked me to bring question 1 to you here under BK-02.3, in relation to PR #3:
